name: @meetdewey/mcp
description: MCP server for Dewey document search and research

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "import('fs').then(fs=>{const f='dist/index.js';const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!'))fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c)})"
